meta.author: MatrixVTT

meta.description: 2d6 + stat; 10+ full hit, 7-9 partial, 6- miss. Ships generic basic moves as scaffolding; replace them with the moves of the specific Powered by the Apocalypse game you are running.
meta.attribution: The Powered by the Apocalypse framework originates in Apocalypse World by D. Vincent Baker and Meguey Baker. This file credits that design lineage and reproduces none of its text.

skills.label: Act Under Pressure
skills.description: When you do something risky while danger bears down, roll 2d6+Cool. 10+: you pull it off cleanly. 7-9: you manage it, but the GM offers a cost, a compromise, or an ugly choice. 6-: it goes wrong and the danger lands.

skills.label: Use Force
skills.description: When you take something by force or threat, roll 2d6+Hard. 10+: you take it and choose the terms. 7-9: you take it, but pick one: you draw unwanted attention, you take harm, or you break something you needed. 6-: they turn it back on you.

skills.label: Charm Someone
skills.description: When you press someone with charm, leverage, or promises, roll 2d6+Hot. 10+: they go along with what you want. 7-9: they need something concrete first, a promise, proof, or payment. 6-: you have shown your hand.

skills.label: Read the Scene
skills.description: When you size up a charged situation, roll 2d6+Sharp. 10+: ask the GM three questions about the scene. 7-9: ask one. 6-: you misread it, and acting on the wrong picture costs you.

skills.label: Read a Person
skills.description: When you study someone in a charged interaction, roll 2d6+Sharp. 10+: hold three questions to ask about them while you interact. 7-9: hold one. 6-: they read you instead.

skills.label: Open Your Mind
skills.description: When you reach past the ordinary, whatever that means in your setting, roll 2d6+Weird. 10+: a clear vision, contact, or truth. 7-9: a partial, distorted, or costly glimpse. 6-: something notices you.

skills.label: Help or Hinder
skills.description: When you help or get in the way of someone rolling a move, roll 2d6+Cool. 10+: they take +2 or -2 to their roll, your choice. 7-9: same, but you expose yourself to the same danger or fallout. 6-: you make it worse for both of you.
